title: Ye roke boli sakina chacha chale aao
body:
Yeh Ro Kay Boli Sakina (Sa) Chacha Chale Aao Hai Chane Wala Andhera Chacha Chale Aao
Adu Ne Aag Lagi Di Hamare Khaimon Main  Hai Shola Khaimon Se Uthta Chacha Chale Aao
Nikale Kis Tarah Bhaiyya Ko Jalte Khaimon Se  Phuphi Ka Bus Nahi Chalta Chacha Chale Aao
Zameen E Garm Peh Uryan Hai Lash Baba Ki  Uthane Un Ka Janaza Chacha Chale Aao
Hamare Sar Se Laeeno Ne Cheen Li Chadar  Alam Ka Le Kay Pharaira Chacha Chalo Aao
Dekha Kay Shimr Bahata Hai Mashk Se Pani  Magar Mujhe Nahi Deta Chacha Chale Aao
